verdict.rationale: Unreal documents a public Remote Control API that runs an in-engine web server with HTTP/WebSocket REST-like endpoints. It can call any Blueprint-callable function and push preset events. Alongside it are a generated Unreal Python API reference for scripting the editor and documented CLI/automation entry points (cook commandlet, UAT, Gauntlet), and probes confirm these docs can be fetched keylessly. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving these APIs, the Python API is marked Experimental, and Remote Control is scoped to same-network access.
